title: ScientificAssessment
description: Schema for append-only scientific verification finding events in VAULT.

finding_id.description: Unique identifier of the verification assessment event

record_id.description: Identifier of the verified scientific record

source_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of original raw record payload

verifier_version.description: Version of the verification rule engine

issues.description: List of flagged discrepancies, arithmetic errors, or expired SOPs

evidence.description: Structured supporting evidence for each check or finding

original_verdict.description: Preserved original verdict from the record without modification

supersedes_id.description: Finding ID of a previous assessment superseded by this new evidence
